summary: Frontend-only verification of new refinements: (a) custom TicketMono font (Roboto Mono w/ personalized 0) as THE ticket font, (b) Whyst Wide restricted to the 'P' of P1:/P2:, (c) tighter star lines for PRODUIT/POIDS NET while header keeps 4px letter-spacing. Tested BOTH surfaces. STANDALONE (/logiciel-ticket-asteo.html): document.fonts.check('12px TicketMono')=true, check('12px Whyst0')=true; window.jspdf.jsPDF + window.html2canvas defined; no pageerror. .wp span contains 'P' with computed font-family='Whyst0, TicketMono, monospace'. .hdr letter-spacing=4px. .tb star lines (PRODUIT/POIDS NET) computed letter-spacing='normal' (visually tight, ~0 — CSS rule .tb{letter-spacing:0} is present; getComputedStyle returns 'normal' but rendered width is tight; header's .hdr 4px override still applied). Overflow test with long provenance + HK-319-GA + 9 400 poidsNet -> 0 offenders. PDF export button.primary -> valid %PDF (4.2MB). REACT root (/): [data-testid=ticket-document] mounts, no pageerror. TicketMono and Whyst0 both check=true. .tk-wp span 'P' computed font-family='Whyst0, TicketMono, "Roboto Mono", monospace' (starts with Whyst0). .tk-hdr letter-spacing=4px. .tk-strong PRODUIT/POIDS NET lines letter-spacing='normal' (same visual behavior as standalone). save-pdf-button -> valid %PDF (1.87MB). No overflow. Screenshots visually confirm the wider Whyst-'P' in P1:/P2: on both surfaces.

issues: getComputedStyle reports letter-spacing='normal' for .tb/.tk-strong (PRODUIT/POIDS NET) even though CSS declares letter-spacing:0. Likely because 'normal' is the initial-computed value that equates to 0 and the browser normalizes 0->'normal'. Visually the stars appear tight (as intended) and the header 4px is preserved — no bug, just note for regression tests to assert either '0px' OR 'normal' (both meaning 0).

critical_code_review_comments: Regression test assertion tip: for the tighter star lines, assert getComputedStyle(...).letterSpacing in ['normal','0px'] since the browser may return 'normal' when the declared value is 0.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested checks pass on both surfaces)

context_for_next_testing_agent: New TicketMono custom font is loaded on both standalone (embedded base64) and React (/fonts/ticketmono.woff2). Whyst0 is used only for the 'P' of P1:/P2: (class .wp in standalone, .tk-wp in React). The per-zero wrapping was removed — zeros now come from TicketMono directly. ASTEO header has letter-spacing:4px, PRODUIT/POIDS NET star lines are tight (computed 'normal' which equals 0). PDF A4 export works on both surfaces. No overflow with long provenance + HK-319-GA.
